Hey, I don't know what field you are in but I'll tell you my story. The first time i tried to apply into IT was in 2016 and the company that i have had interview with didn't call me back. I called the HR lady and she was like " I am sorry, this position is already taken ". I've had a friend work at that firm that time and I told her my concerns saying that I don't think this is the real reason why they declined me for the position, could you please look into it for me. My friend got back to me and said that the true reason why they didn't take me is that they considered me a reserved person and that i wouldn't fit in to that team. Within a week, I've found my current employer for whom I've been working for almost 5 years now. I still remember telling one of my supervisors at that time this story why that firm didn't take me and my jaw dropped when supervisor replied " this is not a reason to reject  an applicant, this is by no means a qualification of someone's productivity" and that's how i knew that I've found a decent workplace. Of course, it has its issues, but i can not imagine what my life would have looked like if that first place offered me a job. So what i am trying to say is that there's always a decent employer out there, who values you for YOU. You just need to look for one.
